title: TRIG MODES: play the trig keys, after the Digitakt II
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: The Digitakt II's trig modes on the Digitakt: NO + PAGE steps through OFF, TRKS (keys 1-8 play audio tracks 1-8, 9-16 the MIDI tracks), VEL (the keys play the active track at 16 velocities) RTRG (hold a key: the active track rolls in time, 1/4 to 1/64 with triplets; keys 9-16 fade out) and RTRK (after the Model:Samples' retrig: keys 1-8 roll their own tracks while held, keys 9-16 pick the rate). A chip in the top corner shows the mode. TRK + trig still picks tracks. Notes are played, not recorded. Needs seq-events.
